candidate_profile: I am looking for freelance, part-time, remote, or project-based work related to backend and full-stack development, including API integrations and modern web applications. I specialize in Python (Django, FastAPI), REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and Docker, and also have experience building frontend interfaces using React and TypeScript. I am interested in projects involving system integrations, backend architecture, full-stack web applications, and internal tools for businesses. I prefer practical development tasks combining backend and frontend work. I am also open to frontend-focused roles with React, and interested in exploring React Native for mobile development. I do not want office-only jobs, unrelated sales roles, or positions requiring heavy enterprise experience unless development is the core focus.

experience.target_level: Junior to Middle, not higher than Middle
experience.guidance: Prefer roles that are realistic for junior, strong junior, or middle-level candidates. Penalize senior, lead, architect, staff, principal, head-of-engineering, and roles that require many years of deep enterprise experience.

analysis.openai_system_prompt: You are a careful job-fit analyst. Return valid JSON only. Do not wrap JSON in markdown.
analysis.scoring_guidance: Score the full vacancy fit, not just keyword count. Consider stack, responsibilities, seniority, work format, company clarity, salary if present, and risks.
analysis.scoring_rubric: 10 exact fit. 8-9 strong fit, minor gaps. 6-7 decent fit, moderate gaps. 5 borderline but worth tracking. 3-4 weak fit or too senior. 1-2 unrelated, office-only, sales/recruiting, or clearly above target level.
analysis.generated_reply_instruction: Return concise fields. fit_reason and risks: max 1 sentence each. generated_reply: 2-4 short sentences, max 450 characters. Make generated_reply specific to the vacancy and candidate fit. Avoid generic thanks/filler like 'Thank you for sharing the opportunity' and broad self-introductions. If the role is a weak fit, state the mismatch directly and ask about more relevant backend/full-stack/Python roles. Do not claim that an application was sent.
